summary: Rubico Inc., a Greek-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq (RUBI), furnished a Form 6-K attaching a September 21, 2026 press release announcing a transition from semi-annual to quarterly reporting of financial results, starting with Q3 and nine-month results for the period ended September 30, 2026, expected in Q4 2026. Quarterly releases will include unaudited condensed statements and operating data but no footnotes; semi-annual IFRS interim statements and the Form 20-F annual report continue. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor or board recommendation is stated; watch for disclosure cadence and governance signals only.
